verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to choose a storage region or data residency for Warp data. Related items cover other things: zero data retention, a claim that terminal data is never stored on Warp servers, and running cloud agents on your own infrastructure. Those concern retention and execution location, not a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
